entities.summary: The Reykjavík Mosque is a mosque and community space for Muslims, located in the Ármúli district of Reykjavík, Iceland. The mosque was opened in 2002 by the Muslim Association of Iceland after requesting the city government for permission to build a purpose-built mosque in 2000.
